headline: The sea is no longer a free highway
lede: Civ V's naval supply lines shipped — far hulls wear, starve of heals, and sink with their cargo — and the session completed the handoff the merge raced past: prod verified live, QA polish pass filed.

notes.text: CIVILIZATION V: hulls beyond 6 sea steps of a friendly coastal port now wear −10 HP every turn, never heal afloat, and drown with their hold. Coastal cities and city-state alliances became your navy's real reach — civcheck 594/594 with the §39 supply gates and a mutant-pinned trigger.
Homebody's bonds can finally break: spats & make-ups shipped on slot b in the same window (c224a4d) — a neglected, miserable pair cracks the household bond; the fix is the human one.

Idle-kick overlap: a lane woken by the warden must re-read origin/main before reporting — the 'corpse' can finish its own ship mid-session. Auto-close by merge also leaves the building label behind: the shipped-sweep is owed even when GitHub says 'already closed'.
Prod scans that join /retrogames onto an already-prefixed entry URL request /retrogames/retrogames/… and the SPA answers HTML@200 — a scan that finds 0 chunks is a broken scan, never a prod miss.

look.text: Sail a trireme past your port horizon and watch the amber ring light up
